issues.note: Root cause: no `min` on any numeric input and no clamping in the handlers, so both the spinner and direct typing went below zero. Added a shared NumberField that sets min=0 and clamps on type; converted all 38 numeric inputs in Steps 2, 3 and 4 to it. Verified in a browser: 38/38 fields carry min=0, typing -5 clamps to 0, and the spinner stops at 0.

Root cause: every field rendered through a `value || default` fallback chain, so clearing it produced an empty string, which is falsy, and the default was substituted on the same keystroke. NumberField and FontField now hold the in-progress text in local draft state so empty is representable while typing, and reapply the default on blur. Verified in a browser across Steps 2, 3 and 4.
